title: How many days are in a hundred calendar years?
description: With a leap day every fourth year, the video counts the days in a hundred calendar years and compares them with a hundred trips of the Earth round the Sun.
teaching_notes: One idea: a hundred years have twenty five leap years, and the calendar ends up ahead of the Earth. Watch for children who count a leap day for every year.

source: With a leap day every 4th year, how many days are in 100 calendar years? Compare with 100 revolutions.
video_script.why: The child has compared four calendar years with four trips of the Earth and now does the same for a hundred years, where the small gap grows.
video_script.substitution: the book's own hundred calendar years with a leap day in every fourth year, against a hundred trips of the Earth of three hundred and sixty five point two four two two days each
video_script.anchor: A hundred calendar years with a leap day in every fourth year, against a hundred trips of the Earth
video_script.wrong_move: A common slip counts a leap day for every year, so one hundred leap days in a hundred years. A leap day comes only in every fourth year.
video_script.payoff_line: The days in a hundred years are now known.

final_answer.value: 36525 days against 36524.22 days, ahead by 0.78 days
final_answer.spoken: thirty six thousand five hundred and twenty five days against thirty six thousand five hundred and twenty four point two two days, ahead by zero point seven eight days

maths_rules: calendar: 100 × 365 = 36500, plus 25 leap days, so 36525 days
compare the parts after 36500: 25 against 24.22, and 25 − 24.22 = 0.78
the calendar is ahead of the Earth by 0.78 days, so too many leap days have been added
the slip: a leap day in every year gives 100 leap days
video_script.design: One idea: both totals begin with thirty six thousand five hundred, so only the extra parts need comparing. Assumes the video on four years. Wrong idea: a leap day in every year. The two totals stay hidden; thirty six thousand five hundred and twenty five and thirty six thousand five hundred and twenty four point two two appear only on the answer beat.
